name: Polymak PM-1100 11kg 1500W 17J SDS-Max Demolition Breaker
shortDescription: Heavy-duty 11kg SDS-Max concrete demolition breaker with 1500W motor, 17 Joules impact energy, and anti-vibration D-handle for structural breaking.
overview: The Polymak PM-1100 is an industrial-class 11 kg demolition breaker designed for rigorous masonry breaking, reinforced concrete trenching, asphalt pavement removal, and wall knockouts. Equipped with a high-torque 1500W copper motor and an oversized electro-pneumatic impact piston, it generates a ferocious 17 Joules of single-impact energy at up to 1890 blows per minute. Its quick-locking SDS-Max chuck holds heavy bull points and flat chisels securely, while the internal vibration absorption mechanism and 360-degree auxiliary side handle shield operators from destructive rebound vibration.
keyFeatures: Heavy-duty 1500W industrial copper motor designed for sustained heavy breaking
17 Joules of destructive impact energy delivers massive concrete removal rates
Standard SDS-Max tool holder for fast, keyless chisel changes and solid power transfer
Pneumatic impact mechanism engineered for low rebound shock to gears and armature
Anti-vibration spring-damped D-handle minimizes operator strain during horizontal and vertical breaking
All-metal magnesium-alloy gear and crank housing for maximum thermal endurance
Continuous grease-pack lubrication eliminates frequent oil reservoir top-ups
applications: Concrete foundation breaking and pile head trimming
Wall demolition and door/window opening knockouts
Floor tile, screed, and bed mortar removal
Trenching for sanitary plumbing and underground conduits
packageContents: 1x Heavy Duty Metal / Blow-Mold Carry Case
